Write a LINQ query in PascalABC.NET to select customers from the USA who have made at least 5 purchases in the last month and have a total purchase amount greater than $1000. Additionally, exclude customers who have made any purchases with a credit card that has expired in the last month.
output:
Assuming you have a `Customer` class with properties `Country`, `PurchaseDate`, `TotalAmount`, `CreditCardExpirationDate`, and a collection `customers` containing all the customers, you can use the following LINQ query:

```csharp
DateTime oneMonthAgo = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1);

var selectedCustomers = customers.Where(c => c.Country == "USA" &&
                                             c.PurchaseDate >= oneMonthAgo &&
                                             c.TotalAmount > 1000 &&
                                             !c.CreditCardExpirationDate.HasValue ||
                                             c.CreditCardExpirationDate.Value >= oneMonthAgo);

var customersWithAtLeastFivePurchases = selectedCustomers.GroupBy(c => c.CustomerId)
                                                         .Where(g => g.Count() >= 5)
                                                         .SelectMany(g => g);

```

In the above query, we first filter customers who are from the USA, have made purchases in the last month with a total purchase amount greater than $1000, and exclude those with expired credit cards.

Then, we group the selected customers by their `CustomerId` and filter out only those customers who have made at least five purchases in the last month.

Note: You will need to adjust the property names, data types, and conditions based on your actual implementation.
